notes.title: Demo Update: Smaller Build, Improved Scaling, and Critical Bug Fix
notes.content: [p]This update includes the following improvements:[/p][p]- Reduced texture sizes which lowered the demo build size from 3.6GB to 1.6GB  [/p][p]- Fixed a scaling issue affecting cutscenes on various screen sizes  [/p][p]- Resolved a critical bug that could lock the player and halt progress [/p][p][/p][p]Reinstall or update the demo to get the latest patch.[/p]
